prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1103; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand. You can go ahead.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light, heading straight. A vehicle coming from my right pulled out and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming until the last second.

Q: Did you brake or swerve before impact?

A: I hit the brakes, but there wasn't enough time to avoid it. My car spun a little from the force.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My lower back hurts pretty badly. I felt a sharp pain right after the collision, and it's gotten worse since. I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and they diagnosed a back strain.

Q: Are you still receiving treatment?

A: I have a follow-up with my doctor next week and I'm doing physical therapy twice a week. I'm also taking prescribed anti-inflammatory medication.

Q: Did you have any prior problems with your back?

A: I had some stiffness a few years ago, but nothing that stopped me from working or doing normal activities.

Q: Were there any passengers in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?

A: Briefly. They said they were sorry and that they hadn't seen my car either.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get my back back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
